D1 及 - 逮: reach; come up to
D2 拘 - 逮: arrest; detain
D3 捉 - 逮: catch; apprehend
D4 掴 - 逮: seize; capture
D5 留 - 逮: detain; hold back
D6 循 - 逮: follow; pursue
D7 得 - 逮: gain; acquire versus apprehend or capture
D8 持 - 逮: hold versus catch or seize
D9 収 - 逮: collect versus capture or seize
D10 過 - 逮: go beyond versus reach or come up to
D11 超 - 逮: surpass versus reach or come up to
D12 越 - 逮: cross over; exceed versus reach or come up to
D13 凌 - 逮: surpass versus reach or come up to
E1 捕 - Compare capture with apprehend and the arrest title; verify the declared direct exclusion.
E2 追 - Compare chase and pursue, including following senses; verify the declared direct exclusion.
E3 届 - Compare reaching, delivery and secondary contact senses; verify the declared direct exclusion.
E4 至 - Compare reaching and attainment, including abstract senses; verify the declared direct exclusion.
E5 達 - Compare reaching and attainment; verify the declared direct exclusion.
E6 着 - Compare arriving and secondary attachment senses; verify the declared direct exclusion.
E7 止 - Compare the stop title with the English arrest ambiguity; verify the declared direct exclusion.
E8 停 - Compare halt and stopping with the English arrest ambiguity; verify the declared direct exclusion.
E9 接 - Compare contact and joining with the source's reaching an opponent; verify the declared direct exclusion.
E10 触 - Compare touching and contact with the source's reaching an opponent; verify the declared direct exclusion.
